name: Extended Aeration Plant Type
changes: Extended Aeration split out as its own plant type in the startup onboarding wizard (previously bundled under Activated Sludge)
Extended Aeration added to Plant Information settings dropdown, matching onboarding
Selecting Extended Aeration in startup setup seeds Target SRT (25 d) and Target MLSS (4,000 mg/L) into Plant Config
RAS/WAS Advisor shows a contextual Extended Aeration guidance banner (low WAS, low sludge production) when that plant type is set
